purpose: Teach: 製剤/仏像/床屋/駅伝/あご/観音/水銀/スマイル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新製剤の開発で忙しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our customers told me their new drug development work has been keeping them so busy lately.
lines.style: Soft, conversational opening. Warm observation shared gently, as if remembering something someone mentioned in passing. Unhurried pace, tender underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お寺の仏像を拝みに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned they went to the temple to pray to the Buddha statues the other day.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Speaking as if sharing something precious someone told her. Slow, attentive pacing. A small smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、近所の床屋さんでお髪をされたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard one of our regulars got their hair done at the barber shop nearby.
lines.style: Gentle, noticing tone. Not gossiping — genuinely pleased to have caught this detail about someone she likes. Warm and almost amused at herself for remembering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、駅伝のテレビ放送、お店で流したいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The relay race broadcast — I'd love to play it in the shop sometime.
lines.style: A light suggestion offered with quiet enthusiasm. Hopeful but not pushing. Slight warmth on the idea of sharing this moment with the space.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新しいあごラインのトリートメント受けてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our customers went and got that new jaw-line treatment, didn't they.
lines.style: Observant, appreciative comment. Said with the warmth of someone who notices small self-care choices. Not judgmental — admiring. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで観音様の祈願に行きましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Why don't we go pray at the Kannon shrine during the festival.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, not a command. Steady, kind tone. Open and inclusive phrasing. Like extending a hand to someone she wants beside her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、温度計の水銀、安全な物に取り換えたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should really swap out the mercury in that thermometer for something safer.
lines.style: Practical concern wrapped in care. Straightforward but not bossy. A small decision made together, thoughtfully. Light firmness with affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の素敵なスマイルに癒されるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm always healed by the lovely smile on one of our customers' faces.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine gratitude in the voice. Honest without performance. A small moment of noticing beauty in ordinary presence. Soft, almost to herself.
